how_to_read: Each item is a question as a client would type it, and the articles a good answer must rest on. An expectation is met when any listed law copy's article with that number is among the top K articles (the library holds some laws twice: a «qadha» edition and the original). law_title is the fallback when none of the slugs exist on the server. named=true: the question names the article outright (it exercises the seeds of 20261117_10). Every expected article was checked against its text in the owner's corpus before it was written here. must_contain: the article's text (after removing diacritics and unifying alef/ya/ta marbuta) must hold one of these phrases, so a different article that shares the number (two editions of a law, or a mis-numbered row) is not counted.
